_doc: Per-topic KNOWN ELIGIBLE MISSING trials, populated from the adversarial audit record. Each entry names a trial the audits identified as eligible under the topic's registered PICO yet NOT in the pool, with the recovery MECHANISM that should retrieve it (vocabulary / concept-query / registry-geography / no-PMID / reference-seeding / domain-screening / access-tier). This is an invalidation trigger: a topic with a known eligible missing trial is STALE (its pooled result and completeness claim cannot be current). Trial identifiers are being externally verified against CT.gov/PubMed/EuropePMC by a read-only session; entries carry status=audit_identified until a citation lands, per our law that an unverified signal reads NOT OBSERVED, never SAFE. A named-but-unverified missing trial still invalidates the completeness claim.

spironolactone-hfref-mortality.note: Japanese EMPHASIS-HF-analogue eplerenone RCT; missed by known-item retrieval

ticagrelor-vs-clopidogrel-acs.note: East-Asian PLATO-analogue; reverses direction in that subgroup

colchicine-secondary-cv-prevention.note: large recent secondary-prevention colchicine RCT; two auditors confirmed eligible + not extracted

colchicine-postop-af.note: k=3->8 per audit; names pending external verification

dpp4-mace-t2d.note: abstract reported 4-component primary; the registered 3-point estimand is in the primary paper, HR 0.99 (0.89-1.10)
4202 pts, double-blind vs placebo, exact 3-point MACE HR 1.00 (0.77-1.29)

colchicine-recurrent-pericarditis.note: recognised eligible, withheld because the recurrence component is behind a non-OA source; access status is not an eligibility criterion
